title: Introduction to Java
description: Learn about Java installation, IDE setup, and basic syntax. Write your first 'Hello, World!' program.

title: Control Structures and Methods
description: Understand and practice using loops (for, while), conditionals (if, switch), and methods. Write small programs that utilize these concepts.

title: Building a Simple Java Application
description: Combine all learned concepts to create a simple Java application. Focus on using variables, control structures, and methods.
